## Circular to All Licensed Corporations

Starting from 1 January 2007, the SFC will fully implement a five-day working week and our offices will be closed on Saturdays.

If you wish to deliver any documents or notifications to us on a Saturday, you may drop them into a mail-box, with a time stamp facility, at 8/F Chater House, 8 Connaught Road Central.

Should you have any questions about this arrangement, you can contact Miss Lorraine Chan at 2842-7751.
